messages:
Raj Kapoor: Morning — async standup. What I did: ran a quick alert-noise sweep, tweaked dedupe rules for redis timeouts. Blockers: still seeing repeated KV-cache flood alerts from host i-0a12 that I can't reproduce locally. Today: triage with oncall, open follow-up ticket, update runbook. @Emma can you confirm you saw the dedupe patch?

Emma Chen: saw it, thanks. After the dedupe change staging alert rate dropped ~60%. Prod still emits ~2 alerts/hr from i-0a12. I opened a temp mute on that metric: https://internal/tickets/INC-1284

Liam O'Neill: oncall handover — I'll own prod triage this AM. If rollback needed, I'll run the rollback annotation; placeholder cmd: `kubectl annotate deployment/runtime rollout=rollback-1718625300` — will post the exact command in the ticket. Question: should we relax the SLO sensitivity for p99 during the triage window?

oncall-bot: Reminder — 2 pending pages in last 24h: redis-timeout (1), model-kv-leak (1). Dashboard: https://obs/internal/oncall

Raj Kapoor: Thanks. Liam, add findings to the ticket I'll create (1718625300-prod-kv-flood). Emma, please attach the last 1h logs. @Maria ping — any ETA on the canary e2e blocker you mentioned yesterday?

Emma Chen: uploaded `errors_1h.log.gz`. Saw repeated `OSError: write timeout` coming from i-0a12 around 02:12UTC. Connection churn seems high. I'll try rotating NAT gateway and re-run smoke tests.

Liam O'Neill: small experiment in staging: bumped connection pool soft limit 100 -> 150, no regressions so far. If that helps, we can ship a small patch tomorrow to prod and monitor.

Maria Gomez: I'm blocked by an env var mismatch causing the canary to fail during auth handshake. Coordinating with eng-runtime to fix; ETA ~2 hours. Will post results in the ticket when fixed.

Raj Kapoor: Good. Also quick ask — can someone review PR #3421 (alert-runbook tidy)? It's mostly wording + step to mute host-level metric. https://gh/repo/pull/3421

Emma Chen: taking a quick look now. Left one inline about mute TTL (should default to 1h not 24h).

Liam O'Neill: Reviewed and approved, left a small nit. :thumbsup:

Raj Kapoor: Awesome — thanks team. I'll create the prod ticket now and add links to logs and experiments. If anything urgent pops up, please page. Otherwise I'll follow up in the ticket and close this thread. :coffee:
